translation: More information about the <bold>#{{id}}</bold> cluster from the ETO Map of Science project
Growth rating is a measure of how fast a given cluster grew in the past 3 years. Clusters that with growth rating below average are blue; cluster with growth rating above average are red.
The total number of clusters is ca. 86 thousand. Only the largest ones are displayed at any given time.
By default, the 500 largest clusters are displayed. The current maximum value is 3000. Higher values may cause the app to slow down.
We're working on major performance improvements, so this limit will be increased in the future.
